title: YACHTSY

services.name: Why Yachtsy
services.desc: Trade the same old dinner reservation for a private cruise. Bring the cake, the candles, and the people who matter - Yachtsy's 18-foot picnic boats make any birthday feel like a milestone, on the water in Baltimore's Inner Harbor or DC's Navy Yard. The whole boat is reserved for your group - bring the cake, a cooler, and a playlist. With seating for eight and a built-in Bluetooth speaker, it's the easiest party you'll ever throw. All ages are welcome, so it works for a kid's big day or a milestone you'd rather celebrate with champagne. You set the course. services.name: private DC boat rental
services.desc: Looking for a Washington, DC boat rental that's actually private? Step aboard a sleek 18-foot luxury picnic boat and cruise the Navy Yard waterfront your way - no crowded tour boat, no fixed itinerary, just you and up to eight guests. Bring your own food, drinks, and playlist, and take in the Anacostia River, the ballpark lights, and the Capitol Riverfront from the best seat in the city: the water. Every Yachtsy rental is always private, so the boat is yours for the full two hours - no strangers, no schedule but your own.
